Sigma magnitude 18 independently corroborated three ways: Litherland lattice count (-18 for T(7,6)), GLM recursion (18), Fairchild Prop 3.1 sigma(6,7)=18; hence |18-21|=3>1 contradiction holds. originality.rationale: EMERGENT_FINDING route verified as genuine: arose from admitted family target T(p,q) q=2 mod 4 via ruling-rigidity+signature route in target_exit, so absence from topic.json is not adverse. CCPRSY indeed leaves q=2 mod 4 open (Thm 1.5 covers only q odd and 4|q; rlk2=0; Conj 6.3 unproven). However Binns-Kang-Simone-Truol arXiv:2109.09187 Thm 1.7(b)+Lemma 2.9+Sec 3.4 proves stronger smooth fact gamma4(T(6,7)) in {2,3} via Alexander stretch 3, i.e. no smooth Mobius (any e) for the mirror of T(-7,6). A decomposable exact Lagrangian Mobius with e=42 is a smooth Mobius, so the headline is substantively implied as a corollary of a known stronger theorem. Fairchild et al restates the same bound. Prior need not state Lagrangian wording verbatim.
